title: Evaluating the Capabilities of LLMs for Supporting Anticipatory Impact Assessment
reasoning: The paper explicitly discusses 'anticipatory governance' and 'anticipatory ethics' as frameworks for mitigating negative impacts of AI. It evaluates LLMs for their ability to generate negative impacts which are crucial for AI impact assessment, a field deeply intertwined with ethical considerations. The qualitative evaluation rubric includes 'plausibility' as a criterion, which assesses the reasonableness of impacts in the socio-technical world, touching upon ethical implications.
